items.title: SoFi Brings SoFiUSD to Mastercard: Can It Unlock a New Growth Engine?
items.summary: SoFi Technologies is integrating its SoFiUSD stablecoin into its debit and credit card program through Mastercard, expected to process over $25 billion in annualized volume. The move capitalizes on accelerating card activity, with Q2 2026 showing $28 billion in annualized card spend and 67% year-over-year growth in interchange fee revenues. SoFiUSD settlement could enhance fee-based revenues and support merchant payments, positioning SoFi beyond its traditional lending business.

items.title: SoFi Announces Monthly Distributions on $THTA (10.00%)
items.summary: SoFi announced monthly distributions for its Enhanced Yield ETF (THTA) with a distribution rate of 10.00% and 30-day SEC yield of 2.93% as of August 14, 2026. The ETF combines U.S. government securities with credit spread option strategies to generate enhanced yield. The article includes extensive risk disclosures regarding derivatives, interest rates, leverage, and liquidity.

items.title: Can a $25,000 Investment in SoFi Stock Make You a Millionaire?
items.summary: SoFi Technologies, an all-digital bank expanding into crypto, AI investing, and blockchain services, has grown revenue 41% year-over-year but remains down 29% year-to-date. While the stock could reward investors as part of a diversified portfolio, turning $25,000 into $1 million would require a 40-fold increase and a market cap near $10 trillion, which appears highly unlikely.
